description: This is a unit test class for the ImmutableJsonArray.ValueListJsonHandler in the package org.eclipse.ditto.json. It tests JSON parsing and handling functionalities related to JSON arrays, verifying behaviors such as parsing empty arrays, parsing specific array strings, and handling null inputs.

classes.name: ValueListJsonHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of ImmutableJsonArray.ValueListJsonHandler for parsing JSON array strings.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test JSON objects and arrays used across test cases.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test fixture before each test method execution by instantiating the handler and parser.

methods.name: tryToParseNullString
methods.description: Tests that parsing a null string throws a JsonParseException caused by a NullPointerException.

methods.name: parseEmptyArrayStringToEmptyList
methods.description: Verifies that parsing an empty JSON array string results in an empty value list.

methods.name: parseArrayString
methods.description: Tests parsing of a populated JSON array string and compares the resulting list with an expected list of JsonValues.
